B: Treats the May 2026 bucket as censored or partial, when censoring applies from 2026-06-01.

raw.verdict: C and B both grounded their work in the same traced corpus call. C went further: it decomposed critical against total coverage, surfaced dated headlines with URLs, and flagged entity-label artefacts. B gave cleaner exports but misread the censoring and omitted headlines. A and D had no measured data; A declined honestly, while D offered memory estimates about a different quantity.
